original_test_intent: Validate the six PDB PSU power channels represented by PWR_PDB_PSU1~6 against the approved electrical specification across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence.
original_method: The PDB/power owner defines installed PSU population and binds each exact sensor to PSU bay/serial, AC feed, PDB connector/rail and output/load domain, including any NVGPU relationship; automation passively collects all fitted channels under a recorded load and redundancy state.
manual_activity: The PDB/power owner approves the six-slot topology, measurement boundary, fitted/absent behavior, redundancy/load-sharing rules and any NVGPU association, then reviews the evidence and issues the verdict.
required_inputs: Exact PWR_PDB_PSU1 through PWR_PDB_PSU6 names, fitted population and empty-slot semantics
Per-index PSU bay/serial, AC feed, PDB connector, rail and downstream load map
Definition of input/output/branch/aggregate power and any channel overlap or summation rule
NVGPU power-domain relationship, if any, without assuming index equivalence
Units, scale, sign, aggregation window, refresh and invalid/stale semantics
Ranges and imbalance/tolerance rules by redundancy, feed, load and power state
SDR entity/description plus Sensor List/Web mapping and same-target revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent PDB/PSU/GPU/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Resolve all fitted exact members and document absent slots; do not query a literal tilde expression as proof
Bind each value to PSU serial, feed and PDB electrical path
Treat `(NVGPU)` as annotation and do not induce GPU load or run an unspecified utility
Do not sum or compare channels across boundaries without an approved aggregation contract
Do not power-control, hot-plug, alter load/driver/threshold/BMC or clear logs
Stop on redundancy, power-good/fault, identity, freshness, thermal or completeness anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source, six-name expansion, fitted population and measurement contract
Verify PSU/feed/PDB/load/NVGPU topology and same-target identity read-only
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, every fitted exact record and BMC Web
Compare values/states/freshness with passive PMBus, redundancy, feed, load, power-good and SEL context
Perform no power service/control, workload, driver action, mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve six-slot PDB/PSU electrical and population map
Define measurement boundary, overlap/aggregation and any NVGPU relation
Provide state-specific limits, imbalance tolerance and absent-slot rules
Review all fitted channels and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES SIX-SLOT PDB POWER-TOPOLOGY AND MEASUREMENT CONTRACT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a six-slot table covering installed/absent state, exact sensor, PSU serial/feed, PDB connector/rail, downstream load and measurement boundary; evaluate each under one timestamped redundancy/load state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes population and electrical coverage explicit and prevents literal range, omitted slots or unsupported channel totals from masquerading as complete evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: PSU PMBus or GPU aggregate power is corroboration only unless the owner maps it to the same PDB measurement boundary.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: PDB channels may represent branches rather than one-to-one PSU outputs, and redundant sharing can be asymmetric; incorrect summation or index mapping can conceal an overloaded rail.

project_override_considerations: Reduced-PSU configurations require explicit expected not-present behavior. Shared rails or summed sensors need a non-overlap rule and synchronized sampling tolerance before totals are compared.
expected_evidence: Approved six-slot installed/absent PSU/feed/PDB connector/rail/load matrix
Measurement boundary, overlap/aggregation, units/scale/window/freshness and NVGPU relation
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus each fitted exact result
BMC Web, same-target proof, passive SEL/platform logs, statuses and hashes

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets six PDB PSU power channels. Population, measurement boundary and NVGPU relation are missing project inputs, not contradictory source fields.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive fitted-channel comparison is identifiable once the owner supplies the six-slot topology and criteria under ED-35/36.

review_improvement: Adds explicit fitted-slot coverage, PDB electrical-path identity and overlap/aggregation controls while rejecting the NVGPU annotation as an executable step.
independent_technical_reasoning: PDB power telemetry can be organized by connector, rail branch or load domain rather than by PSU module. A six-slot PSU label therefore does not prove one-to-one measurement or safe summation; serial/feed topology and measurement boundaries must be established under the actual redundancy state.
